guide.s.overview.title: Overview · Getting started
guide.s.overview.desc: Four tabs at the bottom — take a minute to learn the layout and get started faster.
guide.s.overview.steps: "My Goods" is the collection home: search and view switches on top, summary card and grid below.
Four tabs at the bottom: Collection, Events, Recharge and My — switch with one tap.
The top of the collection page also switches between Collection, Wishlist and Stats views.
Tap the floating + button to add goods; long-press a card for multi-select, batch edit, grouping and sharing.
guide.s.overview.tip: A "back to top" button appears after scrolling; switch light/dark theme under My → Settings.
guide.s.add.title: Adding goods
guide.s.add.desc: Manual entry, batch photo pick, miHoYo shop import, share import or QR import — five ways to choose.
guide.s.add.steps: Tap the + button on the home page and pick an add method: manual, batch, or an import option.
Fill in the name and choose category, IP, character and storage location; both listed price and actual price are supported.
Add multiple images and set the primary one; with quantity above 1 you can record price and date per unit.
Once saved the entry appears in the list; long-press for batch edit or grouping.
guide.s.add.tip: Pre-build categories, IPs and characters in Settings to pick them from a dropdown and power later filters and stats.
guide.s.batch.title: Batch add
guide.s.batch.desc: Pick many photos at once, fill shared defaults in the queue, then fine-tune each item.
guide.s.batch.steps: Choose "Batch add" from the add-method sheet and select multiple product photos.
On the queue page set shared defaults for all items: category, IP, storage location, price, etc.
Tap an item to edit its name, images and price differences.
Confirm and commit everything in one go; quitting midway saves a draft you can resume later.
guide.s.batch.tip: Queue image files are owned by their items — removing or replacing an image cleans up local files too, no double storage.
guide.s.search.title: Search & filter
guide.s.search.desc: Keywords plus multi-dimensional filters and sorting; save common conditions as presets.
guide.s.search.steps: Tap the search button to search by name, IP or character — pinyin also matches.
Combine filters by category, IP, character, storage location and price range in the filter panel.
The toolbar switches sort order, card density and grouping display.
Save the current conditions as a filter preset and apply it later in one tap.
guide.s.search.tip: The search button lights up while filters are active; tap the × next to it to reset everything at once.
guide.s.detail.title: Detail & edit
guide.s.detail.desc: The detail page gathers all fields, the status timeline and per-unit breakdown.
guide.s.detail.steps: Tap a card to open details: large image, price, storage location, notes and custom fields.
For multi-unit items, view price, acquisition date and sale status per unit.
The status timeline records order, arrival and shipping milestones — add new statuses anytime.
Tap edit to change fields; deletion moves the item to trash and can be restored.
guide.s.detail.tip: You can also record a sale right from the detail page — completed sales flow into the sale ledger.
guide.s.groups.title: Groups (sets)
guide.s.groups.desc: Bundle related goods into sets for unified display, stats and sharing.
guide.s.groups.steps: Long-press cards to multi-select, then tap "Create group" to bundle them into a set.
The group detail page shows members and total price with auto or manual summaries.
Groups can live inside collection folders and appear aggregated in the list.
Dissolving a group only removes the relation — the goods themselves are never deleted.
guide.s.groups.tip: Group totals count toward the collection value and sync across devices via cloud sync.
guide.s.wishlist.title: Wishlist
guide.s.wishlist.desc: Keep a separate want-list and always know how much more you plan to spend.
guide.s.wishlist.steps: Toggle "Add to wishlist" when creating a goods entry, or move an owned item to the wishlist while editing.
The wishlist page shows expected total and distribution so you can prioritize.
Convert to collection in one tap once acquired — price and images carry over.
Wishlist shares search, filter, sorting and batch operations with the collection.
guide.s.wishlist.tip: Batch-convert wishlist items to collection at once, or share them with friends for a second opinion.
guide.s.trash.title: Trash
guide.s.trash.desc: Deletes go to trash first; nothing is wiped until you confirm permanent removal.
guide.s.trash.steps: Deleted goods move to trash and disappear from the main list and search results.
Search the trash by keyword and restore items back to the list in one tap.
Permanently remove entries you no longer want — this cannot be undone.
Clearing and permanent deletion always ask for confirmation to avoid mistakes.
guide.s.trash.tip: Deletion state syncs to the cloud, so other devices won't "resync" removed data back.
guide.s.events.title: Events
guide.s.events.desc: Concerts, expos and meetups — tickets, spending and memories in one place.
guide.s.events.steps: Create an event: name, type, dates, city and venue, with map pinning for venues.
Link the goods you got at the event and record tickets, travel and on-site spending.
For performances, build a playlist to play songs and view lyrics in-app.
Event photos and notes are stored together for later reminiscing.
guide.s.events.tip: The event map shows all venues you've visited with one-tap navigation.
guide.s.recharge.title: Recharge & monthly cards
guide.s.recharge.desc: Record game top-ups one by one; monthly card claims and expiry at a glance.
guide.s.recharge.steps: Tap + on the recharge page: pick the game, amount, date and payment channel.
Records aggregate by time; the stats page shows monthly top-up curves and composition.
The monthly card calendar shows claim status and expiry for every card.
Enable monthly card expiry reminders in notification settings so you never miss a claim.
guide.s.recharge.tip: Multi-currency amounts are supported and auto-converted to CNY for statistics.
guide.s.stats.title: Statistics
guide.s.stats.desc: Character rankings, spending composition and collection value on one screen.
guide.s.stats.steps: The stats view aggregates owned count and spending per character into a leaderboard.
Charts show category composition, monthly spending trends and collection growth.
Total collection value includes sets and per-unit details, matching the list's calculation.
Switch the statistics range to view different periods.
guide.s.stats.tip: Wishlist and collection are counted separately — wants are never mixed into owns.
guide.s.sale.title: Sale ledger
guide.s.sale.desc: Sales, listings, recovery and profit/loss — every resale tracked clearly.
guide.s.sale.steps: Record a sale from the detail page or batch actions — as "sold" or "listed".
The ledger summarizes recovered amount, active listings and overall profit/loss.
Multi-unit items can be sold unit by unit with separate prices and dates.
Filter details by time and status to review your resale rhythm.
guide.s.sale.tip: Listed items stay in your collection and move out automatically once sold, counting toward recovery.
guide.s.import.title: Import data
guide.s.import.desc: miHoYo shop, Taobao orders, share codes and backup files — all importable.
guide.s.import.steps: miHoYo shop import: configure the account or paste cookies to pull orders in bulk.
Taobao order import: paste order content and products with prices are recognized automatically.
Share import: open a friend's link or enter a code to add the whole list to your collection.
Backup import: pick a JSON backup file under Settings → Data to restore everything.
guide.s.import.tip: A preview is shown before importing so you can drop unwanted entries first.
guide.s.sync.title: Cloud sync & backup
guide.s.sync.desc: Supabase multi-device sync — or stay fully local if you never enable it.
guide.s.sync.steps: Sign in under My → Cloud sync and enable sync to upload data automatically.
Incremental merge compares timestamps; newer edits win on conflict.
Network failures retry automatically and the sync page shows clear error reasons.
Export a JSON backup from Settings → Data regularly for an extra local copy.
guide.s.sync.tip: On a new phone, sign into the same account with sync enabled to restore everything.
guide.s.share.title: Share with friends
guide.s.share.desc: Generate a share link for your list — friends can preview and import it.
guide.s.share.steps: Long-press to multi-select goods and tap Share to create a link without private fields.
The share management page lists all links — disable or delete them anytime.
Friends open the link to preview the list and can import it whole into their own collection.
Create multiple links by theme and share them with different friends.
guide.s.share.tip: Shares stay in sync with your current collection; disabling a link revokes access immediately.
guide.s.theme.title: Theme · Language · Notifications
guide.s.theme.desc: Appearance, language and alerts — configure them to your taste.
guide.s.theme.steps: Switch light, dark or system theme on the theme page; colors and card styles apply globally.
Language settings support Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean.
Notification settings manage sale reminders, monthly card expiry and character birthdays.
Set a monthly or yearly collecting budget on the My page with automatic over-budget alerts.
guide.s.theme.tip: Theme preference applies at startup, so light/dark switching never flashes.
guide.s.faq.title: FAQ
guide.s.faq.desc: High-frequency questions about data safety, sync troubleshooting and storage.

guide.s.faq.items.q: Where is my data stored? Can it be lost?
guide.s.faq.items.a: Everything lives in on-device SQLite, with optional cloud sync and periodic JSON exports — three layers of safety.
Check your login and network, then retry from the cloud sync page. If it still fails, submit logs via My → Feedback and we'll investigate.

guide.s.faq.items.q: Many images — do they bloat storage?
guide.s.faq.items.a: Cloud images use a display cache with a size cap; least-recently-viewed cache entries are evicted automatically. Originals are unaffected and can be re-downloaded.

guide.s.faq.items.q: How do I migrate to a new phone?
guide.s.faq.items.a: Sign into the same account with cloud sync on to restore automatically; or export a JSON backup on the old device and import it on the new one.

guide.s.faq.items.q: How do I report ideas or bugs?
guide.s.faq.items.a: Use My → Feedback with logs attached; you can also tell us via announcements and surveys.

guide.s.faq.tip: The guide evolves with releases — type keywords into the top search box to jump to a section.
